name: ISCX VPN-nonVPN
environment: Controlled Alice/Bob application captures; OpenVPN UDP.
classes: 14 original service/tunnel categories; derived task counts differ.
labels: Application and service labels from controlled captures.
caveats: Curator: preserve capture provenance; VPN-App and VPN-Service are derived tasks, not independent original collections.
preprocessing: Flow extraction; paper-specific header masking and sampling.

name: ISCX Tor/non-Tor
environment: Paired workstation/gateway captures; non-Tor portion reuses VPN-project traffic.
classes: Service labels; exact task mappings vary.
labels: Workstation activity labels propagated to Tor gateway flows.
caveats: Source explicitly documents reused non-Tor data; audit overlap with ISCXVPN.
preprocessing: Flow extraction; paired captures must not be treated as independent.

name: USTC-TFC2016
environment: Benign application and malware traffic collection.
caveats: Curator: not wholly encrypted; source and malware-family differences can become shortcuts.
preprocessing: Session/flow splitting, byte cropping and anonymisation differ across papers.

name: CIC-IDS2017
environment: Five-day lab capture, 3–7 July 2017; generated user behaviours.
classes: Benign traffic plus scheduled intrusion scenarios.
size: Five daily captures; source lists 11, 11, 13, 7.8 and 8.3 GB.
caveats: Documented audit: Engelen et al. 2021. Curator: fixed attack schedules make random splits a weak deployment test.
preprocessing: CICFlowMeter features; distinguish original and corrected versions.

name: CSE-CIC-IDS2018
environment: Generated profiles; victim infrastructure of 420 machines and 30 servers.
units: Traffic captures, system logs and flow features
caveats: Curator: this is a separate collection from CICIDS2017; corrections to one do not transfer automatically.

name: CICIoT2022
classes: Device and activity labels; exact per-paper selection needs verification.
caveats: Curator: do not confuse this dataset with attack-centric CICIoT2023.

name: Cross-Platform / FlowPrint
environment: Android and iOS app traffic collected for FlowPrint.
caveats: Curator: distinguish app overlap from a genuinely unseen platform or collection.

name: CSTNET-TLS 1.3
labels: Server Name Indication used to label flows.
caveats: Curator: SNI-derived labels and shared-flow packets need careful isolation; ECH changes label visibility.
preprocessing: ET-BERT preprocessing; at most 500 flows / 5,000 packets per class.

name: MIRAGE-2019
environment: Human-generated mobile app traffic via MIRAGE capture architecture.
classes: Mobile apps; exact class count not extracted.
labels: Ground truth generated by collection architecture.
caveats: Curator: device, user and capture grouping should be retained during splits.
preprocessing: tcbench FlowPic transforms are one derived representation.

name: MIRAGE-COVID-CCMA-2022
environment: Human-generated mobile communication traffic in the MIRAGE series.
caveats: Curator: separate from MIRAGE-2019; do not assume identical label space.

name: UCDAVIS19 / QUIC
environment: QUIC traffic with automated and human activity partitions.
classes: Five applications in the cited collection.
units: Packet time series and flow representations
caveats: Finamore et al. investigate human/script distribution shift; keep those partitions distinct.
preprocessing: Sampling of size/time/direction; FlowPic variants use size-time histograms.

name: UTMobileNet2021
environment: Mobile-app collection used in the replication study.
classes: Exact class and collection details need verification.
caveats: Dataset identity and use verified through replication; official dataset documentation awaits extraction.

name: netFound pretraining corpus
environment: Campus network telemetry described by the authors.
size: Paper: 4.2 billion flows; repository rounds to 4 billion / 1.2 TB.
caveats: Curator: release is advertised; bulk data and its privacy claims have not been independently audited.

name: NetBench suite
environment: Benchmark assembled from seven existing public collections.
caveats: Curator: not a new independent capture; audit overlaps with underlying training collections.

name: IoT-23
environment: Malicious and benign IoT traffic scenarios.
caveats: Curator: retain scenario boundaries and distinguish device identity from attack behaviour.
preprocessing: Zeek logs or raw PCAP processing.

name: CTU-13
units: Labelled bidirectional flows and capture resources
labels: Background is not equivalent to proven benign.
caveats: Curator: preserve scenario boundaries; old malware does not represent all modern attacks.

name: MAWI traffic archive
caveats: Curator: identify exact date/samplepoint; time and address anonymisation affect model inputs.

name: CAIDA trace collections
environment: Internet measurement collections; no single universal CAIDA dataset.
caveats: Specific trace used by a paper needs verification; no universal collection year exists.

name: CipherSpectrum
environment: Firefox and customised Chromium website captures, January–March 2024.
caveats: Curator: balanced browser captures do not establish cross-organisation or open-world validity. Download form required; CC BY-NC 4.0.
